title: Rust: TCP Server (Simulated)
description: Simulate a TCP server and client using in-memory communication patterns.

steps.title: Simulated TCP Listener
steps.description: Create a `SimulatedListener` that receives connections. Use a channel-based approach where `accept()` returns a connection from a queue. Print when a connection is received.

verification.failureMessage: Create a listener, accept a connection, and print.

steps.title: TCP Echo Server
steps.description: Create an echo server: read a message from the simulated connection and print the response. The server echoes back `Echo: ` + message. Simulate the full request-response cycle.
hints: Create a request/response pair using channels.
Server receives request, creates echo response.
Client sends message, receives echo back.

verification.failureMessage: Send 'Hello' and print the echo response.

steps.title: Multi-Client Server
steps.description: Handle multiple clients concurrently. Spawn a thread for each connection that handles requests. Simulate 3 clients connecting and sending messages.
hints: Spawn a thread per connection using `thread::spawn`.
Each thread reads from a dedicated channel.

verification.failureMessage: Handle 3 concurrent clients and print their messages.

steps.title: Protocol Parser
steps.description: Create a simple text protocol: messages are newline-delimited. Write a `read_line` function that accumulates bytes until `\n`. Parse a buffer and extract complete messages.
hints: When `\n` is found, extract and return the line.
This is how HTTP and Redis protocols work at a lower level.

verification.failureMessage: Parse a buffer into complete messages and print them.

steps.title: Full Server Simulation
steps.description: Combine everything: a simulated server that accepts connections, reads messages, processes them, and sends responses. Simulate a key-value store with SET and GET commands.
hints: Server maintains a `HashMap<String, String>` for storage.
Parse command format: `SET key value` or `GET key`.
Client sends 3 SET and 2 GET commands, server responds.

verification.failureMessage: Simulate SET and GET commands and print server responses.
